title: Paul McCartney live: Sportaréna, Budapest | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Papp László Sportaréna in Budapest, Hungary, on 15 May 2003.

It was the 26th date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Sportaréna on 28 June 2011.
